item.description: Ohio State has three unanimous All-Americans in the same season for the first time ever. item.description: The 2025 College Football Playoff field includes Ohio State’s opponents from some of its most iconic victories of all-time as well as some of its most painful recent losses. Ohio State has the chance to create a new chapter in its history against as many as three of those opponents in this year’s CFP, starting with a quarterfinal game on New Year’s Eve against whoever wins Saturday’s first-round game between Texas A&M and Miami. item.title: Ohio State Lands Four-Star Linebacker Quinton Cypher for Class of 2027
item.description: James Laurinaitis is on the board in the class of 2027. Four-star linebacker Quinton Cypher, the No. 192 overall prospect and No. 11 linebacker in the current junior class, committed to Ohio State over fellow finalists Alabama, Miami and Georgia on Friday. Cypher hails from Raleigh, North Carolina, where he's a tackle machine for Millbrook High School. item.title: Michigan Misses on Two Top Head Coach Targets As Kalen DeBoer Leads Alabama to First-Round CFP Win, Kenny Dillingham Signs Contract Extension at Arizona State
item.description: Michigan’s coaching search took two big hits in less than 10 hours. Going into Friday night’s first-round CFP game between Alabama and Oklahoma, Michigan was reportedly still holding out hope that it could lure Kalen DeBoer away from Tuscaloosa if the Crimson Tide lost to the Sooners. The Wolverines’ other top target was believed to be Arizona State coach Kenny Dillingham. item.title: Amare Bynum Makes First Career Start For Ohio State Against North Carolina in CBS Sports Classic
item.description: It was a matter of when, not if, Amare Bynum was going to become a starter for Ohio State this season. That opportunity happened 11 games into his college career, as Bynum made his first career start for OSU against North Carolina in the CBS Sports Classic in Atlanta on Saturday afternoon. item.description: The oddsmakers were not impressed by Miami's win in College Station. item.title: Remember When: Woody Hayes Allowed BBC Documentary Film Makers into the Locker Room Prior to Ohio State's First-Ever Meeting with the Miami Hurricanes
item.description: Woody Hayes was notoriously paranoid. His elevated suspicion was both renown and largely reserved for That Team Up North. But as he began what would become the twilight of his coaching career, he opened the locker room doors to his program for documentary filmmakers to capture the world of Ohio State football, which was completely under his control as the 1977 season began.
